paired vertical elements hanging or descending from the arms/shoulders
justification: Both surfaces present a frontal anthropomorphic figure with symmetrically extended/downward arms, a torso marked by a circular disc motif and a horizontal banded element, so the general body scheme roughly corresponds in placement. But A is a fully drawn, colourful, active figure with legs, an elaborate radiating pectoral, headdress, weapons in each hand and multiple hanging trophy-like objects, whereas B shows only a rigid, legless, low-relief block-like figure with faint incised curls and rings and no held objects — the specificity and manner of depiction differ greatly.
